data.subject: Public-record research for your fund
data.body:
Hi,

Your June 30, 2026 13F shows positions in FCBM and FRST.

On September 18, 2026, FCBM disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1531193/000110465926108950/tm2625756d1_8k.htm).

Local Ledger publishes independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records—permits, agendas, call reports, and filings—with every claim cited.

May I send the free weekly issue and set up a four-week fund pilot? Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
